prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Kyokotsu, white-haired skeletal yokai rising from a well.
ANATOMY: ONE clean bleached human SKELETON with one skull, TWO dark empty eye sockets, TWO bony arms and TWO legs hidden beneath a fully opaque WHITE ragged garment; long tangled WHITE HAIR on skull [kyokotsu-c02]. No flesh, blood, wounds or eyes in sockets. Skeletal hands anatomically five fingers. One plain old wooden BUCKET attached by rope near waist [kyokotsu-c03].
MOMENT: Heave upward toward viewer from a deep stone WELL, one bony hand claws over well rim near camera and other pulls the wet wooden bucket against chest; skull leans over rim in angry open-jawed confrontation, tangled white hair whips upward. White garment drags wetly over stone.
POWER: Rises from well attached to bucket [kyokotsu-c03], intense resentment [kyokotsu-c04,kyokotsu-c07]. No visible curse spells, green light or energy; physical emergence only.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; very low close well-rim camera, skull/bonyhand dominate foreground, wellmouth and bucket visible; no giant size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant low amber moon or natural sun as specified, deep walnut shadows, hard rim light, physical spray or dust.
SURFACE: tactile bleached bone, coarse opaque cloth, wet hair, stone and wood, premium painterly brushwork.
SETTING: Old stone well [kyokotsu-c03,kyokotsu-c07].
MOOD: imposing active encounter, never cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, pseudoletters, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, eyes, limbs or fingers; no film, game, anime or comic designs; fully opaque clothing on humanoids; no nudity, blood or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, floating runes or energy ribbons.

aura: Documented anatomy and active manifestation supply force without generic aura.
artistic_choices: Use Sekien skeletal form rather than later curse narratives; bones clean/dry without gore. No magical curse effect invented.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native and 200px inspected: clean skull/two empty eye sockets, long white hair, white ragged garment, two skeletal arms with five-digit foreground hand; bucket and rope attached beside torso, rises over stone well rim. Angry open-jaw emergence, no flesh/gore, visible curse effect, text or aura. All Sangar criteria pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and skull, foreground-hand and bucket-hand crops. One bleached human skeleton (kyokotsu-c02): one skull with TWO empty dark eye sockets (no eyes, no flesh) and an open screaming jaw, long tangled white hair streaming upward (c02), and a fully opaque ragged white shroud-garment (c02/c12) with only a sliver of ribs at the neckline. The foreground bony hand clamps the wet stone well rim with four fingers plus a thumb (5 digits). The other hand hugs a rope-bound wooden bucket to the chest with five digit rows, and the rope runs around the waist to the bucket (Sekien's figure rising from a well attached to a bucket, c03). It physically emerges from an old stone well, with a wooden well roof and pulley rope, under a hazy amber moon (white bones in a well, c07). The furious open jaw conveys the grudge (c04/c07) without inventing any curse effect. Extreme low rim-level camera and dripping water: frightening and dominant at 200px. No blood, gore, text, aura or borrowed design.
